toolbar.snap_tip: Toggle snapping. Hold Ctrl while dragging to invert it.

toolbar.icons_tip: Show light, particle, and audio icons

settings.code_editor_tip: If the launcher is not on PATH, enter the full executable path.
settings.build_tools_tip: Leave empty for automatic discovery (vswhere, VULKAN_SDK, PATH). Fill in only if a tool is not found or you want to use a different one. Applies to this user on this computer.
settings.tool_check_hint: Checks with the values entered, even before applying.
settings.auto_save_tip: The material and animation editors write every change at once. Off: only Save writes, and leaving unsaved changes asks first.
settings.backup_tip: Set 0 to turn backups off. The latest snapshot of each scene is stored in editor/backups in the project folder.
settings.backup_failed: Could not save the scene backup.
settings.system_resolution_tip: Uses the resolution of the monitor the game starts on (under the mouse cursor).
settings.collision_tip: Choose a layer and select which layers it collides with. Physics bodies use their mesh layer, or Default if there is no mesh.
settings.input_tip: Scripts query actions with ctx.ActionDown("Jump") or ctx.ActionHit("Jump").
settings.action_invalid: Each action needs a unique name.
settings.runtime_backend_tip: Play builds the project runtime for this backend.
settings.reorder_scenes: Drag and drop scenes to reorder them.
export.output_tip:
Creates a distributable release under
Build/<Config>-<Backend>. The first export takes a few minutes.
hierarchy.delete_children: Child objects will also be removed.
gpu_timing.title: GPU Time per Pass
gpu_timing.unsupported: The active backend has no GPU timestamps.
gpu_timing.note: Smoothed over about 0.5 s. Passes with the same name in several views are added up. Measuring runs only while this window is open.
tonemap.title: Tonemapping
tonemap.exposure_tooltip: Exposure in EV stops: +1 doubles, -1 halves the brightness before tonemapping. No effect under OpenGL (frozen).
script.relative_asset: Path relative to Assets, e.g. Prefabs/Bullet.prefab

script.reveal_toggle: Reveal script in the Asset Browser. Use the arrow to expand or collapse.
script.reveal: Reveal script in the Asset Browser
transform.local_tip: Local values are relative to the parent, or to the world if there is no parent.
transform.world_tip: World space uses global axes, position and rotation.
transform.world_rotation_disabled: World rotation is disabled when the parent has non-uniform scale because it would shear the child.
camera.align_to_view_tip: Sets this camera's position and orientation to the current editor camera.
light.align_to_view_tip: Sets this light's position and direction to the current editor camera, so it shines where you are looking.
mesh.drop_model: Drop a model from the Asset Browser here.

animation.key_hint: Click a keyframe to see and edit its values.
animation.key_current_tip: Stores the current pose of the selected object at the playhead, without moving anything.
animation.title: Animation
animation.rec_tip: While recording, every change to the object or its bones at the current time becomes a keyframe.
animation.select_object: Select an object in the hierarchy first.
animation.empty_hint: Select an object with an Animator. Add one in the inspector: + Component > Animator.
animation.play_active: The animation editor is paused while the game is running.
animation.missing_bone: Bone has no object in the hierarchy:
material.make_copy_tip: Create a separate copy of this material for this object and open it in the material editor
material.local_values_tip: This object keeps its own material values from an older scene. Changes in the material editor do not reach it until you reset them or save them as a copy.
physics.no_collider: A rigid body without a collider is excluded from simulation.
physics.trigger_not_simulated: The trigger box is excluded from physics simulation.
physics.sphere_scale_tip: Non-uniform scaling uses the largest axis.
physics.character_origin:
The origin is at the feet. Script controls:
SetMoveVelocity, Jump, IsGrounded.
physics.character_rigidbody:
This character also has a rigid body.
Use one of the two components.
physics.character_push: Controls how strongly the character pushes dynamic objects.
audio.drop: No file. Drag an audio file from the Asset Browser here.
audio.play_mode: Playback is available in Play mode.
audio.listener_help:
The scene's listening point, usually on the camera.
Use one listener per scene.
particles.radius_tip: Particles spawn randomly inside a sphere around the origin. A radius of 0 spawns them at the origin.
particles.local_velocity_tip: The direction follows the object's rotation.
particles.floor_tip: Particles bounce off a horizontal plane shown as an orange grid in the viewport.
particles.relative_floor_tip: On: height follows the emitter. Off: fixed world height (Y).
particles.bounce_tip: 0 = no bounce, 1 = bounce at full speed.
particles.floor_friction_tip: Slows sideways movement on each impact.
particles.default_texture: No texture. The default is a soft disc. Drag an image from the Asset Browser here.
particles.bar_active_tip: Emitters keep spawning particles. Off: only bursts and script particles.
particles.bar_loop_tip: Emission repeats after its duration. Off: stops after one pass.
particles.flipbook_tip:
Image containing multiple frames, in row order.
1 × 1 uses the full image.
particles.flipbook_custom_tip:
Custom frames are active.
Changing columns or rows switches back to the grid.
particles.flipbook_custom_active: Custom frames active – changing the grid resets them
particles.frame_range_warning: A stored frame index exceeds the atlas. Playback uses the nearest valid frame.
particles.clip_name_warning: Use a unique name with 1–64 characters. Duplicate names resolve to the first clip.
particles.preview_legend: Cross = pivot · Line = floor contact · Outline = frame 0
particles.frame_drag_tip: Drag a frame to move it, its bottom-right corner to resize, or the circle to move the pivot. Editing a grid creates individual pixel frames.
particles.grid_edit_limit: Reduce the grid to at most 4096 non-empty cells to edit individual frames.
physics.fit_box_tip:
Fits the box to the mesh bounds.
Other collision settings are preserved.
environment.title: Environment
prefab.unpack_tip: Detaches the object from its prefab. It stays in the scene; prefab changes no longer apply.
prefab.reset_instance_tip: Removes local overrides from the instance and its children while preserving the instance's position and rotation. This action can be undone.
inspector.group_tip:
Ctrl+click to deselect an object.
Click without Ctrl to clear the group selection.
physics.box_from_mesh: Creates a box collider from the mesh bounds.
physics.default_box: Creates a 1 × 1 × 1 box, for example as a trigger zone.
physics.sphere_exists:
A sphere collider is already present.
Add more shapes as collider children.
physics.sphere_from_mesh: Fits a sphere around the mesh bounds using the largest half-extent as the radius.
physics.capsule_exists: A capsule collider is already present.
physics.capsule_from_mesh: Creates a capsule along Y and fits it to the mesh bounds.
physics.character_exists: A character controller is already present.
physics.character_help:
Moves across floors, slopes and steps.
Controlled by script (SetMoveVelocity, Jump).
audio.listener_tip: The scene's listening point, usually attached to the camera.
particles.exists: A particle emitter is already present.
particles.help: Smoke, fire and sparks with a preview in the viewport.
physics.rigidbody_exists: A rigid body is already present.
physics.sphere_child_tip: Creates an empty child with a sphere collider.

material.texture_activate:
Click to activate the slot.
Drag a texture from the Asset Browser here.

material.texture_card_tip: Drag to connect. Double-click to reveal the texture in the Asset Browser.
material.graph_input_tip: Drag an output here. To disconnect, right-click or drag the link into empty space.
material.graph_hint: Drop textures or right-click to add nodes. Drag from an output to an input.
material.graph_value_input: This input takes a Value node.
material.graph_texture_input: This input takes a Texture node.
material.graph_disconnect_tip: To disconnect, right-click or drag the link into empty space.
material.graph_custom_hint: Drop shader files onto the source nodes or enter shader code. Custom shaders only use Texture nodes.
material.graph_shader_drop: Drop a shader file here or enter its path
material.graph_shader_copy_hint: The code is saved as a new shader file next to the material.
material.graph_shader_save_error: Could not create or connect the shader file.
material.graph_link_error: Invalid link. Assign up to four different textures and use connections without cycles.
material.graph_uv_input: This input expects a scalar or a 2D value.

material.graph_texture_limit: The graph needs more than four texture or UV slots.
material.graph_parameter_default: Start value until a script sets it

material.select_asset: Select a material in the Assets panel to edit it here.
material.name: Material Name
material.uv_per_node: UV is set on the texture nodes (scale, offset, scroll).
material.uv_direct_only: Applies only to textures set directly; texture nodes have their own UV values.

script.class_missing: Script class not found in the project. The entry and its %zu stored values will be preserved.
physics.enabled_tip:
Off: the object and its colliders are excluded from physics.
Settings are preserved.
physics.type_tip:
Static: stays in place and blocks other objects.
Dynamic: responds to gravity, forces and collisions.
Kinematic: follows the transform from scripts or animation
and pushes dynamic objects.
physics.ancestor_rigidbody:
Parent object “%s” already has a rigid body.
This rigid body is ignored.
physics.parent_position: With a parent, the position is converted to parent space at runtime.
physics.compound_tip:
Add more shapes as children.
Together they form one body, such as an L shape.
physics.rigidbody_owner: Belongs to the rigid body on “%s”
physics.static_obstacle: Without a rigid body, the collider acts as a static obstacle such as a wall or floor.
audio.spatial_tip:
Off: 2D at the same volume everywhere, e.g. music and UI.
On: volume decreases with distance from the listener.
particles.restart_tip: Restarts the preview. If the emitter is disabled, the burst is shown once.
particles.prewarm_tip: Fills the effect with already simulated particles before the first frame. Requires looping. Click Restart to see it in the preview.
particles.loop_duration_tip: Duration of one cycle. A new burst starts the next cycle.
particles.duration_tip: Particles are emitted at the selected rate for this duration, then emission stops.
particles.random_frame_tip:
On: each particle shows a random still frame, e.g. a puff of smoke.
Off: frames play over the particle's lifetime, e.g. an explosion.
physics.capsule_height_tip:
Overall height including both hemispheres.
Below twice the radius, the shape is a sphere.
physics.trigger_tip:
Triggers do not block objects or appear in raycasts.
Scripts receive OnTriggerEnter and OnTriggerExit
when another object enters or leaves the box.
physics.dynamic_help:
Simulated dynamically: can fall, roll and be pushed.
If no collider is present, a box is created automatically.
physics.box_child_tip:
Creates an empty child with a box collider.
Move and rotate it to build compound shapes such as an L shape.

prefab.model_read_only: In Model View, choose Save as Prefab to create an editable copy.
prefab.no_root: Prefab not saved: no entity present.
prefab.multiple_roots: The prefab needs exactly one root entity. Drag the other entities under it.
inspector.active_tip:
Disables the entity for both rendering and systems.
Equivalent to SetActive() in Unity.
inspector.visible_tip:
Toggles rendering for an entity with a mesh.
Systems and transforms continue to run.
inspector.persistent_tip:
This entity survives LoadScene() and UnloadScene().
Child entities need their own setting.

controller.title: Controller
controller.empty_hint: Open a controller by double-clicking it in the asset browser or with "Open" on the animator in the inspector.
controller.clip_missing: Clip is missing or cannot be loaded.
controller.no_exit: State without a way out: its clip does not loop and no transition leaves it.
controller.deleted_parameter: A condition uses a deleted parameter; the transition never fires.

controller.entry_arrow_tip: Start arrow, not a transition: it points at the start state. Change it: right-click a state → "Set as Start State".

controller.preview_select_tip: Select an object whose animator uses this controller.
controller.preview_restart_tip: Restart: parameters to their defaults, the start state from the beginning.
controller.live_preview_tip: While the preview runs, the value fields show and set the preview's values. The defaults in the file stay unchanged; edit them when no preview runs. Restart goes back to the defaults.
controller.live_play_tip: In Play the value fields show and set the real parameters of the selected object. The defaults in the file stay unchanged.
controller.fire_tip: Sets the trigger; the next matching transition consumes it.
controller.fire_pending: Set: waits for a transition that consumes it.
animation.events_tip: Events: right-click adds one here. Click a marker to select it, drag to move, Del deletes.
animation.event_name_tip: One word, no spaces. Scripts get it in OnEvent as event.name.
controller.preview_stop_tip: Stop the preview: the animation window shows the object's clips again, with gizmos.
